cartoon_prompt: Create an original woodland game asset sheet, clean hand-drawn CARTOON style matching the reference's fine outlines, cel shaded olive foliage, warm wood and muted violet-grey rocks. 2D front-facing elevated top-down RPG viewpoint. A useful collection of INDIVIDUAL isolated assets, not a map or connected template. Arrange 25 assets in five neat rows with generous solid pure green #00FF00 space between them, NO drawn grid, no text, no borders, no labels. Row1 five square ground tiles with artwork to tile edge: plain grass, lightly tufted grass, golden dirt, irregular stone paving, blue water. Row2 five terrain pieces: grass topped front cliff straight segment, left outward-facing cliff corner, right outward-facing cliff corner, half-height grass ledge, quarter-height grass ledge. Make front and side rock faces clearly visible, varied stones not identical columns. Row3 five distinct trees: rounded oak, tall slender tree, broad asymmetric tree, pine, small sapling. Row4 bush, fern, flowers, stump, fallen log. Row5 large boulder, tall rock, small rock cluster, grass tuft, mushrooms. No platforms or ground shadow underneath isolated nature objects. Keep all objects intact without touching or clipping. All consistent scale and lighting. Sharp smooth cartoon linework, not pixel art, not realistic, no blur. Background uniformly opaque neon green.

Row1: square plain grass texture, square grass tuft texture, square dirt texture, square stone paving texture, square water texture, all fill edge-to-edge without outlines around the tile squares. Original shapes, readable silhouettes, clean pixel craftsmanship. Fully intact objects, generous margins. This sheet is PIXEL ART only.
